title: phasecmd: policy and profile load errors fall back silently; a --persona-override without ':' is ignored; two coherence commands duplicate each other
summary: Found by comment-reduction batch 15 (2026-09-26) and reported without changing code. (1) loadObserverPolicy and resolveStallPolicy each load policy.json and silently fall back to a zero Policy on error. (2) phasesValidate swallows the profile loader's List and Get errors. (3) A --persona-override value with no ':' is silently ignored. (4) A bogus pgid becomes 0, and phaseobserver.Run does not reject it, so it relies on a downstream guard. (5) The RunPhases usage and 'unknown subcommand' text omit check-coherence and check-artifact-coherence. (6) phasesCheckCoherence and phasesCheckArtifactCoherence are near-duplicates, and mergedCatalog is a pass-through wrapper. (7) TestPhasesCreate_RejectsRootOutsideProjectAndRoots ends with a leftover `_ = root`.
fix: Report load errors as a coded WARN, or fail, instead of falling back to zero values. Reject a malformed --persona-override and a zero pgid at the flag boundary. Derive the usage text from the subcommand table so it cannot drift. Fold the duplicated coherence commands into one command, and inline mergedCatalog.
acceptance: A malformed policy.json yields a visible warning from observer/stall resolution (test)
The usage text lists every registered subcommand (test that iterates the table)
